ep_01.title: A Scandal in Bohemia - Part 1
ep_01.llm_insights: The episode starts with a strong hook as the King arrives in disguise, establishing immediate stakes. Tension dips slightly during the expository backstory but accelerates rapidly as Holmes formulates his plan to retrieve the photograph. The cliffhanger at the end is exceptionally intense as Holmes realizes Irene Adler has outsmarted him, leaving the listener desperate for the resolution.

ep_02.title: A Scandal in Bohemia - Part 2
ep_02.llm_insights: Tension remains constantly high as Holmes executes his scheme at Briony Lodge. A massive peak occurs exactly when the fire alarm is triggered, causing Irene to reveal the hiding spot. However, the intensity tapers off toward the end as Holmes reflects on his defeat, resulting in a moderate cliffhanger.

ep_03.title: The Red-Headed League - Part 1
ep_03.llm_insights: The setup is somewhat comical, leading to a slower initial build. As Holmes discovers the true nature of the pawnshop assistant and the strange league, tension steadily climbs. The sudden dissolution of the league creates an excellent cliffhanger.

ep_04.title: The Red-Headed League - Part 2
ep_04.llm_insights: The climax happens in the vault, generating an early tension peak. After the confrontation with John Clay, the rest of the episode is primarily resolution and explanation, creating a pacing lull that is less likely to convert a paywall effectively.

ep_05.title: A Case of Identity
ep_05.llm_insights: A relatively low-stakes mystery. The narrative lacks a severe threat, meaning tension peaks are muted. The reveal relies entirely on deduction rather than action, making this a risky episode for aggressive ad placements.

ep_06.title: The Boscombe Valley Mystery - Part 1
ep_06.llm_insights: The murder investigation starts slowly but escalates dramatically as Holmes uncovers physical evidence that contradicts the obvious suspect. The episode cuts off right as Holmes claims he knows the true identity of the killer, making for an extremely monetizable cliffhanger.

ep_07.title: The Boscombe Valley Mystery - Part 2
ep_07.llm_insights: The episode maintains high tension as the real killer confesses and his tragic backstory is revealed. The tension stays consistently elevated but doesn't culminate in a massive cliffhanger, opting for a morally complex resolution.

ep_08.title: The Five Orange Pips
ep_08.llm_insights: The sheer threat to the client's life keeps tension high throughout. The peak occurs when Holmes realizes he is too late to save the client. The story concludes with Holmes's revenge, maintaining a strong emotional hook to the very end.

ep_09.title: The Man with the Twisted Lip - Part 1
ep_09.llm_insights: Watson finding Holmes in the opium den provides a great initial hook. The tension builds nicely as the impossibility of Neville St. Clair's disappearance becomes clear, ending right before Holmes vists the jail cell.

ep_10.title: The Man with the Twisted Lip - Part 2
ep_10.llm_insights: The dramatic sponge washing scene in the cell creates a huge tension spike early on. After the reveal, the pacing settles into a lengthy explanation, creating a lull that makes late-episode ad placement risky.

ep_11.title: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle
ep_11.llm_insights: A lighthearted start with the goose transforms into a high-stakes jewel theft investigation. The tension climbs as Holmes traces the goose back to its source, ending with an unexpected confrontation.

ep_12.title: The Adventure of the Speckled Band
ep_12.llm_insights: Perhaps the most consistently tense story. The nocturnal stakeout in the dark room builds incredible suspense. The climax is visceral and terrifying, offering a massive peak that justifies both ad and paywall placements.
